title: Shared Chore Balance Across Household
dataSources: Baby feedings (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), school departures (`school:departure`), stroller activity (`stroller:walk`), household chores (`chore:event`), and family geofence events (`family:location`).
app: Family and baby telemetry from baby-tracking apps, school and geofence automations, stroller logs, chore trackers, and shared-home events streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chore:event status="done"
| stats count as chores_completed by person category
| sort - chores_completed
description: Shows how completed chores are distributed across people and categories in the household.
value: Domestic fairness is easier to discuss with real history than with feelings alone, especially in busy weeks.
implementation: Track completed chores from a shared checklist or Home Assistant to-do workflow and group them by person and category.
visualization: Stacked bar chart of completed chores by person and category.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks who has been getting more of the chores done around the house lately.
